content_sections.heading: MANIT Bhopal Non-Teaching Vacancy 2026 - Post Details
content_sections.text: MANIT Bhopal has announced 55 vacancies across eight non-teaching posts under Group B and Group C. The recruitment includes backlog vacancies and reservations for PwBD and Ex-Servicemen as per Government of India norms.

tables.caption: MANIT Bhopal Non-Teaching Category Wise Vacancy 2026

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for MANIT Bhopal Non-Teaching Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Superintendent: Bachelor's Degree or Master's Degree in the prescribed discipline with the required marks. Senior Assistant: 10+2 or relevant educational qualification with prescribed typing and computer proficiency. Junior Assistant: 10+2 from a recognised board with the required typing speed and computer knowledge. Technical Assistant: Relevant B.E. / B.Tech / MCA / Engineering Diploma / B.Sc. / M.Sc. qualification, as applicable. SAS Assistant: Bachelor's Degree in Physical Education or equivalent qualification as prescribed. Library & Information Assistant: Relevant Bachelor's Degree with qualification in Library and Information Science. Senior Technician: 10+2 with Science / ITI / Engineering Diploma in the relevant trade, as prescribed. Technician: 10+2 with Science / ITI / relevant Engineering Diploma qualification. Required marks, typing speed, experience and other post-specific conditions must be checked in the detailed MANIT Bhopal recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in MANIT Bhopal Non-Teaching Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: MANIT Bhopal has announced a total of 55 vacancies for Group B and Group C non-teaching posts, including Superintendent, Senior Assistant, Junior Assistant, Technical Assistant, SAS Assistant, Library & Information Assistant, Senior Technician and Technician.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for MANIT Bhopal Non-Teaching Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 10 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. When does the online application process start for MANIT Bhopal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: According to the notification, the online application process is scheduled to start on 12 November 2026. Candidates should confirm the application link on the official MANIT Bhopal website.

faq.question: Q4. What qualifications are required for MANIT Bhopal Non-Teaching Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Educational qualifications vary by post and may include 10+2, ITI, Diploma, Bachelor's Degree or Master's Degree in the relevant discipline. Candidates must check the detailed notification for exact post-wise eligibility requirements.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for MANIT Bhopal Non-Teaching posts in 2026?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive salaries under Pay Level-3 to Level-6 of the 7th Central Pay Commission, depending on the post. Applicable allowances will be governed by institute rules.
